svg.title: Mind Map Studio: three views of one project, and focus on one branch
svg.desc: A looping animation in four scenes. 1: on the mind map canvas, Tab adds a child node and Space folds a branch, which then shows a +3 badge. 2: Alt+Right arrow focuses on the Launch Plan branch; the rest of the map clears and a breadcrumb bar reads Product launch, Launch Plan. 3: in the Brainstorm outliner ideas are typed with Enter and nested with Tab, then Copy to map turns them into map nodes. 4: Split view shows the Brainstorm beside the map’s Outline, each pane editable.

g.text: Branches on both sides. Tab adds a child; Space folds a branch.
Alt+→ works in one branch as if it were the whole map.
Enter for the next idea, Tab to nest it, then copy the ideas to the map.
The Brainstorm beside the map’s Outline. Click a pane to type in it.
